title: "Edith Sophia Jacob - The Gate of Paradise: A Dream of Easter Eve"
book_id: 483

## Publication Information

**Date:** 1868

**Imprint:** London: Nister

**Notes:** This appeared originally in<i>MP</i> (June 1867) 534-43. The first edition was anonymous, but subsequent editions attribute it to Edith Sophia Jacob, and the 1918 edition includes a memoir by her brother the Rt. Rev. Edgar Jacob.
